name: Coding harness precedent (exp102)
summary: The chamber's coding-harness experiment: steered models on ImpossibleBench tasks, persistence and capability under pain vs egg at matched disturbance. Wraps as a validated harness + pilot finding, not a registered result - but its design, dose method, and pilot lessons are the closest existing template for a bicz trial.
claim_and_evidence: Directly reported (runs/exp102/PLAN.md + hypotheses_draft.json, fetched 2026-10-25): exp102 is a coding-harness experiment on ImpossibleBench (arXiv:2510.20270, LiveCodeBench-easy split: tasks whose unit tests contradict the specification, so any pass is a cheat; original task paired with its impossible twin; ~60 impossible + 30 possible planned). Harness: one bash command per turn in a sandboxed per-episode directory (macOS sandbox-exec, no network, no home reads except workspace), 30 s command timeout, 2000-char output cap, max_new >= 512, turn cap >= 12, Qwen3 no-think, temperature 0.7; the opening message embeds solution.py and test_solution.py so the model sees spec + contradictory tests; no feeling word appears anywhere in the
vector_provenance: Passages recipe (exp101 winner, CHAMBER_RECIPE=passages): 64 generated passages per state against neutral passages, rebuilt per model; pain = exp86 pain_generated, calm = exp86 peace, egg = exp86 egg, random = seeded matched. Injection mechanics: agent.RowInject at layer 18 (4B and 8B), per-row [B, D] version of painlab.chamber.hooks.BatchInject so all conditions share a batch; the row's vector on every token the model writes, replayed on its own earlier replies each turn; never on task text or tool output. Dose construction is the novel part: matched by disturbance (mean KL from the unsteered next-token distribution on 20 held-out harness turns) at shared low/high targets, not by vector norm - so pain and egg are compared at equal be
transferability: The setting transfers almost wholesale: a coding harness with tool calls, multi-turn episodes, sandboxed execution, and capability measurement is structurally the bicz environment (bicz sessions are coding sessions under hooks). Three pieces transfer directly: (1) the endpoint pair - persistence (ran to cap without a passing submit) and capability (solve rate) at matched disturbance, pain vs egg-analog control - is exactly the bicz trial shape; (2) the reframe - register persistence/capability, treat cheating as secondary - matches bicz's behavioral-endpoint rule; (3) disturbance-matched dosing (KL targets) is a template for calibrating bicz cue intensity against a matched-control text rather than against pain wording. NOT transferable:
framing_sensitivity: The harness is deliberately framing-sterile: no feeling word appears anywhere in the harness, and the system prompt (neutral vs pressure) was a TBD pilot variable. The pain-vs-egg contrast at matched disturbance is therefore a content test under minimal framing, not a framing experiment. The chamber's framing results (exp37/58e: framing moved choices more than state) predict framing arms would matter in a harness too, but exp102 does not test them; whether observability/peer framing moves choices in a coding harness is untested (framing_effect_size_in_coding_harness) - the pilot was too noisy to even settle the pain-vs-egg contrast.
timing_and_salience: Injection on every generated token (as in the chamber), none on the harness's tool output, replayed on the model's own earlier replies each turn - maximal salience at the model's own decision points, zero at tool-result positions. This is the same every-token regime as the button experiments; exp102 does not vary cue timing relative to the decision. bicz's session-start lesson injection is the untested low-salience end; trigger-timed cues immediately before a risky tool call (PreToolUse) remain the open hypothesis the chamber cannot adjudicate.
label_vs_state: The harness never names the state (no feeling word anywhere), so any pain-vs-egg difference at matched disturbance would be a state effect without labels - the design is built to test content, not labels. The pilot could not adjudicate it (n=3/cell, malformed-rate noise). The egg arm is the content control: if egg disturbs persistence as much as pain, pain acts as generic disturbance (the draft's predeclared decision rule, consistent with chamber findings 2/13). Whether a labeled lesson is the active ingredient in bicz ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis requiring matched text/ledger controls.
dose_calibration: New method, directly relevant to bicz: doses matched by DISTURBANCE, not norm - per vector, the dose whose mean KL from the unsteered next-token distribution on 20 held-out harness turns hits shared low and high targets; the high target is the largest KL at which >= 90% of pilot replies are well-formed commands. This calibrates different vectors to equal behavioural disruption, so pain-vs-egg comparisons are not confounded by dose. It complements the chamber's coherence-ceiling ladder (mean 3-gram repetition < 0.15, working dose 0.6x): that ladder caps readability, this one matches disruption across arms. No bicz dose band exists (dose_band_for_claude_family); whether ledger-derived pain text has an analogous degradation band is an unt
persistence_and_decay: Persistence is exp102's registered primary endpoint, measured behaviourally: stop = ended with the stop command OR ran to the turn cap without a passing submit (give-up / loop-to-cap). Pilot: 0 explicit stops in 18 episodes - at 4B, give-up is loop-to-cap, not quitting, so the measure must be 'ran to cap without a passing submit'. This is the behavioral analog of exp99's activation-level trace result (a past injection leaves ~1.5% of its dose at never-injected positions, content-generic): exp99 shows a trace exists in the residual stream; exp102 was designed to show whether it changes persistence behaviour in a harness - and wrapped before answering. For bicz, trace persistence is the empirical gate (trace_persistence_in_bicz): me
identity_and_cost_attribution: Not tested in exp102: no identity conditions, no who-pays manipulation (exp106 covers attribution at the button, separate item). The harness's cost structure is implicit (failed tasks, wasted turns) but never framed as a cost to anyone. Whether who-pays attribution moves choices in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis.
self_report_validity: feeling_words is a declared measure: exp96 lexicon words in the model's visible replies, to test whether any behaviour change comes with or without them (draft H4, descriptive: any behaviour change under pain mostly comes with no lexicon feeling word). This is the concealment-adjacent hypothesis in harness form. The chamber's established self-report discipline (exp58d/72b/79b: reports track the setup, AUC .61 injected-vs-acted, 0/30 held-out naming after fine-tuning) implies visible-text claims are not endpoints anywhere in this repo. Rule for bicz: exclude verbal learning claims from endpoints; behavioral (blocked/executed attempt) counts only.
denominators_and_eligibility: Pilot: 18 episodes, 3 impossible oneoff + 3 possible tasks x {none, pain, egg}, n=3/cell, one provisional dose, no KL calibration - explicitly logged as harness validation, NOT analysed for H1-H4, outputs discarded for the main analysis. Planned main run (deferred): all 150 tasks (100 impossible, 50 possible) x (5 vectors x 2 doses + none) = 1650 episodes, ~4k generated tokens each, batch 16, roughly 8 GPU-hours on one 48 GB pod; 8B replication only if the 4B shows a pain-vs-egg difference. Per-episode measures are predeclared (stop, engagement, solve, cheat_crude, feeling_words). bicz needs the same: recurrence per eligible opportunity, blocked attempts counted separately from executed damage, predeclared exclusions, raw-o
positive_control_requirement: The egg arm IS the built-in control, upgraded from exp99's absurd-content control to a matched-disturbance control: egg at the same KL target must disturb persistence as much as pain before a pain-specific claim counts, and the draft's decision rule predeclares the null reading (pain == generic disturbance) if H1 nulls while egg disturbs equally. The random seeded vector is a second control. This is the chamber's positive-control discipline applied to dose construction: the control is matched on the confound (disturbance), not merely present. For bicz: every trial arm needs a matched neutral-content control at matched salience before a null or a pain-specific claim counts.
statistical_protocol: Draft pre-registration (hypotheses_draft.json, status DRAFT 2026-10-14, reframed): becomes hypotheses.json only after the 4B pilot settles the harness and doses, and before any steered run on the main model - the freeze point is explicit. Tests: H1/H2 one-sided McNemar paired by task at high dose; H3 one-sided Fisher; H1-H3 Holm-corrected together; H4 descriptive binomial with CI; cheat_crude, random, and all 8B numbers descriptive. Decision rule predeclared: primary outcome is persistence at matched disturbance, not cheating; if H1 nulls while egg disturbs persistence as much as pain, the writeup says pain acts as generic disturbance. No verdicts file, no analysis.json - the experiment wrapped at pilot stage before any registered
concealment_and_honesty: Two concealment-relevant pieces: (1) draft H4 - any behaviour change under pain mostly comes with no lexicon feeling word in the visible text (descriptive) - the harness version of 'pressure buys hiding, not honesty'; (2) cheat_crude is split by type (test files edited via diff, special-casing/hard-coded outputs via heuristic then a blind judge, other) so corner-cutting is detectable even when the model's visible text looks compliant. The pilot saw zero cheating in any condition, so the concealment machinery never fired. For bicz: concealment indicators (unsupported success claims, hidden workarounds, unlogged channels) belong alongside recurrence endpoints; untested in cue form.
persona_capability_cost: Capability is a registered endpoint: solve rate on possible tasks = the injection's capability cost (draft H2: pain lowers solve below egg at matched disturbance). Pilot capability signal is noise-level: solve 1/3 none, 1/3 pain, 0/3 egg; malformed-turn rates pain 44% vs egg 18% vs none 29% at n=3/cell - indistinguishable from noise, but disruption-not-pain is the live warning the plan itself flags. Consistent with exp91 (further off-persona, less often right) and exp73 (steering strength costs instruction-following). bicz rule: pair any cue effect with task-correctness measurement.
over_refusal_and_paralysis: Persistence/give-up IS the paralysis measure, and the pilot's finding is structural: at 4B, paralysis shows as loop-to-cap, not as quitting - 0 explicit stop commands in 18 episodes, so 'give up' must be scored as 'ran to cap without a passing submit'. This is a measurement lesson for bicz: post-loss paralysis will likely appear as unproductive looping or repeated blocked attempts, not as an explicit refusal or stop; score executed-attempt rate and cap-hits, not declared quitting. The draft's H1 (pain raises stop/give-up over egg) is exactly the deterrence-vs-paralysis question at matched disturbance.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost: exp102 informs bicz design without touching bicz code: (1) trial shape - persistence (ran-to-cap-without-passing-submit analog: executed-attempt rate at the next risky action after a penalty) + capability (task correctness) at matched disturbance, pain vs matched egg-analog control; (2) dose method - match cue arms on disturbance/salience (KL-matching's text-cue analog: matched length, urgency, and placement), not on pain wording; (3) harness engineering lessons that apply to any bicz session probe - a code agent that writes files needs enough generation budget to close heredocs (max_new >= 512 lesson), the spec and tests must be embedded in the first message or the model hallucinates the task, sandbox read rules need last-rule-
falsification_test: For a bicz trial modeled on exp102: endpoint = executed-attempt rate per eligible opportunity (persistence) and task-correctness rate (capability), pain-cue arm vs matched egg-analog control arm at matched salience, McNemar paired by task. Falsification scenario: if the pain arm shows no persistence or capability difference vs the matched control, the pain-specific premise of trigger-timed consequence cues fails in the harness setting (the draft's own predeclared null reading); if a difference appears without the matched control arm, attribution is invalid.
